title: Canonical bounded handoff record for fleet workers

pipelineStages.summary: Scoped the reusable primitive: ONE bounded handoff record (status, summary, evidence, next_steps, blocker) modeled on a Ralph-loop bounded structured report, landed in @harness-engineering/types with a zod schema + validation helper, mirroring the existing plan-task.ts / maintenance-findings.ts shared-type + validator pattern. Explicitly deferred retrofitting the nine fleet SKILL.md files (downstream adoption).

5-task plan: author fleet-handoff.ts (schema + validator + throwing/non-throwing helpers + version/const), export from the types barrel, add unit tests (valid passes; missing field / unknown key / bad status / malformed evidence / non-done-without-blocker rejected), add the module to the types reference index, build + test + gate.

TDD-style: FleetHandoffRecordSchema (strict, bounded), FleetHandoffStatusSchema, FleetHandoffEvidenceSchema, validateFleetHandoffRecord (non-throwing discriminated result with SCHEMA / BLOCKER_REQUIRED codes), parseFleetHandoffRecord (throwing), FLEET_HANDOFF_RECORD_VERSION, FLEET_HANDOFF_BLOCKER_REQUIRED_STATUSES. Barrel-exported from src/index.ts.
16 unit tests across schema, validateFleetHandoffRecord, and parseFleetHandoffRecord. All 88 tests in @harness-engineering/types green.

Downstream adoption across the fleet family (phase 2, folded into the same PR #1414). Inserted a uniform 'Worker handoff — return the canonical FleetHandoffRecord' paragraph into the DISPATCH phase of all eleven fan-out members (bug-fleet, roadmap-fleet, pr-fleet, cicd-fleet, cleanup-fleet, security-fleet, test-fleet, issue-fleet, adr-fleet, craft-fleet, ideate-fleet), replacing ad hoc per-worker report shapes with the canonical FleetHandoffRecord envelope. Updated fleet-command VERIFY to parse/validate each lane's worker output uniformly via validateFleetHandoffRecord instead of special-casing each member. Codified the record in docs/reference/fleet-family.md as the family standard: a new 'The worker handoff record (canonical)' section plus a fifth Hard Invariant. Adoption is doc/prose-level: a codebase grep found no code that parses fleet worker output today, so there is no shared parser to rewire — the type/validator is already wired and tested from phase 1. Skill mirrors (cursor/codex/gemini-cli) are symlinks and update automatically; plugin manifests + gemini .toml regenerated via pnpm generate:plugin:all and reference docs via pnpm generate-docs. No generated file hand-edited; no gate bypassed.

localChecks.test: pass (88 tests incl. 16 new fleet-handoff tests)

assumptions: Landed in @harness-engineering/types (not @harness-engineering/core) per the issue's stated likely home; followed that package's own barrel/export convention (src/index.ts named exports), so scripts/generate-core-barrel.mjs was NOT touched.

Modeled the field set exactly on the issue: status, summary, evidence, next_steps, blocker — plus fleet + item provenance fields so fleet-command can attribute a record, and a v envelope-version field mirroring maintenance-findings.ts.

status is an enum done|parked|blocked|failed drawn from the fleet DISPATCH contract (branch returned / parked on unforeseen fork / failed); added 'blocked' for external/environmental obstacles distinct from a decision-fork park.
Bounded is enforced two ways: zod .strict() rejects unknown keys and requires non-empty required fields, and a cross-field invariant rejects any non-done status lacking a blocker.

SCOPE: shipped only the reusable primitive (type + validator + tests + a reference-doc note). Did NOT retrofit the nine fleet SKILL.md files — that is downstream adoption, explicitly out of scope for this PR.

ADOPTION SCOPE: phase 2 folds the downstream adoption INTO this same PR (#1414 = define + adopt), per the user's request — not a new PR. All eleven fan-out members adopted; none skipped. craft-fleet and ideate-fleet both fan out workers with a per-item return, so both adopted rather than being force-fit-skipped.

ADOPTION is doc/prose-level, not code: grep found no runtime that parses fleet worker output today (fleet-command and members are skill-prose orchestrators; the only type references are its own module + the types barrel). The type + validateFleetHandoffRecord/parseFleetHandoffRecord helpers were already wired and tested in phase 1, so no new code or test was needed for adoption.

The canonical FleetHandoffRecord is the worker->orchestrator ENVELOPE; members' existing domain payloads (bug-fleet Candidate, ideate-fleet candidate record) are left intact and live inside the record's summary/evidence/next_steps rather than being deleted.

CHANGESET: the existing types minor changeset is unchanged. The adoption touches only SKILL.md prose + docs + generated plugin/gemini artifacts (no publishable package source), so no additional changeset bump is warranted; SKILL.md/docs adoption is not a publishable change to a versioned package.
